area.comingSoon: Iki gice ni kimwe mu bigize uru rutonde.

wellbeing.saved: Icyemezo cyo kwinjira cyarashyizwe ku murongo.
wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Gufunga ibintu mu gihe cy'icyumweru, ibyumweru bibiri, ukwezi, cyangwa burundu.

community.noPhone: Umubare wa telefoni ntiwigeze ugaragazwa mu butumwa bwo kuri interineti.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Jya utuma umuntu ushyigikiye uwo muhungu cyangwa uwo mwashakanye agera hafi yawe.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Ibyo mu by'ukuri bihanagura amakuru yawe kandi ntibishobora gukurwaho.
safety.wipeConfirm: Ndabyumva neza ko ibi bihanagura amakuru yanjye.

reentry.noSteps: Intambwe zo ku rutonde rw'ibisabwa ntiziratangwa.
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Amafaranga atangwa mu buryo butazwi, kandi nta nomero za telefoni zigaragazwa.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Ni iki cyagufashije gufata uwo mwanzuro?
reentry.celebrationFirst: Intambwe ya mbere yarangiye — murakaza neza mu rugo.
reentry.celebrationAll: Intambwe 33 zose zarangiye. Jya wizihiza amajyambere yawe.
reentry.crisisStep: Bika iyi mibare ubu. Urashobora kandi gukanda kuri Nkeneye ubufasha ubu hejuru ya buri ekran.
reentry.resourceOnly: Igishushanyo mbonera cy'umutungo gusa — Groundwork ntabwo gitanga ibi cyangwa ngo gikorane n'ababitanga.

steps.step3: Gutangira porogaramu ya ID ya leta
steps.step6: Shyira mu murongo umuntu umwe ushyigikiye
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Reba ibyangombwa byawe n'amasaha ntarengwa yo kurekurwa
steps.step10: Wemeze itariki ya mbere yo kwinjira n'imimerere
steps.step13: Jya utanga telefoni, imeri na interineti ku buntu
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step15: Shyikirana n'inzego zishinzwe gusubiza abantu mu gihugu
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step18: Reba aho uruhushya rwo gutwara ibinyabiziga rwawe ruri
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step22: Shaka igihe cyo kujya kwa muganga
steps.step23: Gufata gahunda yo kwivuza indwara zo mu mutwe
steps.step27: Gusaba akazi ku bakozi baguhaye amahirwe ya kabiri
steps.step29: Jya ufungura konti muri banki kandi uteganye uko uzakoresha amafaranga
steps.step31: Jya wongera gushyikirana n'abagize umuryango wawe, kandi niba ari ngombwa, ujye utanga amafaranga y'ubufasha bw'abana
steps.step33: Ishyirireho intego ushobora kugeraho mu gihe cy'iminsi 90, maze wizihize

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Byigenga byanze bikunze. Sangiza gusa igihe uhisemo.

venue.placeholder: Icyicaro — icyumba cy'isanduku y'icyatsi. Amafoto nyayo y'ahantu habera ibitaramo ntiyatangajwe; iki si ahantu nyako.

family.help: Abagize umuryango wawe babona gusa ibyo wahisemo kubwira abandi.

readAloud.title: Gusoma mu ijwi riranguruye
readAloud.help: Gusoma mu ijwi riranguruye bikoresha ijwi ry'igikoresho cyawe kugira ngo usome amagambo mu ijwi riranguruye.

phase3.resumeHelp: Jya wandika ibikubiye mu mibereho yawe mu magambo yoroheje.
phase3.headline: Umutwe w'ibitabo
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.mentorshipHelp: Jya ushaka umujyanama cyangwa umuhe akazi.
phase3.geoHelp: Umugi wawe ni wo wonyine ugaragarizwa abandi, ariko aho uherereye ntihagaragazwa.
phase3.rideHelp: Jya usaba umuntu ngo akujyane, telefoni ntizigera zigaragazwa, mujye muhurira mu ruhame.
phase3.partnersHelp: Mu matsinda mato y'abantu batatu, buri wese agenzura uko abandi bamerewe.
phase3.caption: Umutwe w'amagambo
phase3.qaHelp: Jya ubaza mu buryo butazwi, ibisubizo biza biturutse ku banyamuryango bari kure.
phase3.merchHelp: Nta kintu na kimwe kiri ku gifubiko kigaragaza icyo bisobanura, kandi nta n'itariki yashyizweho.
phase3.shareHelp: Ikarita imwe igaragaza uko ugeze ku ntego iba ifite agaciro.
phase3.archiveHelp: Jya wandika akabaruwa kuri wowe ubwawe, kakaba kaboneka ku munsi w'ingenzi.
phase3.matchHelp: Umukozi wawe azabanza avugane n'abandi bagenzuzi.
phase3.override: N'ubwo bimeze bityo, jya usaba gutangira
phase3.datingOff: Kugirana imibonano mpuzabitsina birarangiye kugeza igihe hashyizweho itegeko ry'iminsi ntarengwa.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Ahantu ha mbere ho kureba. Guhitamo, ku rwego rw'umujyi gusa: reba ugiye mu nama yawe kandi uhuze binyuze mu butumwa bwo muri porogaramu. Nta nomero za terefone, nta hantu nyaho.
phase3.groupsHelp: Amatsinda yo gukira, amatsinda ashyigikira gusubira mu gihugu, n'amatsinda y'amadini n'ay'abaturage hakurikijwe umujyi n'amasaha y'amateraniro.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Byerekanwa gusa iyo nta muntu n'umwe uri ku rutonde rw'abajyana n'abandi mu modoka ugiye mu nama yawe.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Kubera ko nta muntu n'umwe washoboraga kujyana na we muri iyo nama, "Needs a Ride" yagaragajwe ari icya kabiri.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Abashoferi bemerewe gusa. Pings zigenda rimwe na rimwe mu gihe cy'iminota 2; wemeza mbere y'uko contact ikurikira igenda.
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.calcResult: amezi yo kugera ku ntego yawe
phase3.musicHelp: Amashusho y'indirimbo gusa, nta konti zo guhererekanya.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Mu gihe uri mu cyiciro cy'amasomo, umuzika uba wazimye.
phase3.shareWho: Muri iki gihe: ni wowe wenyine. Gukora umurongo bituma umuntu wese ufite uwo murongo awusoma.
phase3.suggestHelp: Ibitekerezo gusa — nta kintu na kimwe cyasohotse kugeza igihe ubyongereyeho.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Ni wowe wenyine ushobora kubona ubu butumwa.
crisisReply.inboxEmpty: Nta kintu na kimwe kiri hano.

translationCheck.notice: Nyamuneka suzuma ubuhinduzi inshuro ebyiri kugira ngo urebe ko buhuye na verisiyo y'icyongereza.
